title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Satellite 6.17 security update
description: Red Hat Satellite 6.17 has received a security update addressing multiple vulnerabilities across various components including openvox-agent, openvox-server, puppet-agent, puppetserver, satellite/iop-vmaas-rhel9, and yggdrasil-worker-forwarder. The issues include cookie injection, heap buffer overflow, invalid pointer dereference, denial of service via multiple vectors, access control bypass, HTTP request smuggling, and man-in-the-middle attacks. These vulnerabilities affect components such as curl, Bouncy Castle for Java, Eclipse Jetty, jackson-core, jackson-databind, golang libraries, and gRPC-Go. The update is rated as important by Red Hat Product Security and fixes are available for these issues.
